Name: Clint. New Look
Author: pinzol
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]UPDATED FOR 1.6. SEASONAL + FESTIVAL OUTFITS || OPTIONAL FOR CLINT REFORGED[/size][/color][/b]

A lore friendly new look for Clint. I admit, I wanted a hot blacksmith so I made one. I'm simple like that. Wish I could change his personality just as easily too (and maybe one day I will, actually).


[size=5][b]What's New:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#e69138]Seasonal Outfits[/color], coded for 1.6.
[*]Festival outfits: 1 for the [color=#e69138]Flower Dance[/color] and 2 outfits for the [color=#e69138]Spirit's Eve [/color](One of the Spirit's Eve's outfits will unlock only after Emily's 8H-event. And Clint will randomly wear either one or another costume from then on).
[*]Clint will wear his [color=#e69138]Work Outfit[/color] at the Blacksmith's shop.
[*]Slightly edited [color=#e69138]Blacksmith's shop[/color] (You can turn it off in the settings).
[*]Added an optional version of my mod to use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18345]Clint Reforged Mod[/url]﻿ by SoftPandaBoi [color=#00ff00](Please, read below how to Install it propelry)[/color]
[/list] ﻿- All A[color=#e69138]dditional Portraits and Sprites[/color] are in place. [color=#e69138]Wedding Sprites[/color] included.
﻿- [color=#e69138]Flower Dance[/color] animation is included. 
﻿- I added [color=#e69138]Clint's Spouse Portrait[/color] (the Traveling Cart will be randomly selling it if you're married to Clint).
﻿- Included my edit of [color=#e69138]Clint's Patio and Spouse Room[/color] (you can disable it in the settings).


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6380/6380-1736364467-395014628.gif[/img]

-------------------------------------------------
[color=#ffff00][b]
How to install the main version of the mod [Clint New Look 1.6]:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Have the LATEST version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿installed.
[*]Download [Clint New Look 1.6] version of my  mod and drop the folder inside it into your Mods folder.
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod's folder manually.
[/list]
[color=#ffff00][b]How to install [Clint For Reforged 1.6] version of the mod:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Have the LATEST version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿installed.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18345]Clint Reforged[/url]﻿ mod first.
[*]Download [Clint For Reforged 1.6] from my files and drop the folder inside it into your Mods folder[color=#f4f4f4].[/color]
[color=#00ff00]﻿- ([/color][color=#00ff00][b]Important Note:[/b] my portraits and sprites will completely override original Clint Reforged mod's art. Any settings at all).
[/color][*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change config.json file in the mod's folder manually.
[/list]
-------------------------------------------------

[b][color=#e06666]Warning:[/color]
[/b]This mod can and will conflict with any other mod that changes Clint's appearance.
It will also conflict with mods that changes Blacksmith shop map. Just set mod's settings to "false" in config if you do not wish to use my version of the shop. So, pay attention, guys :)

-------------------------------------------------
[color=#00ff00]
[/color][b][size=3][color=#00ff00]Credits and thanks![/color]
[/size][/b]
[color=#f4f4f4]All credits for [/color][b]Spirit's Eve [/b]and[b] Flower Dance [/b]outfit[color=#f4f4f4] designs for Clint go to [/color][b][color=#ff7700][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me]Poltergeister[/url][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4] and [/color][b][color=#ff7700][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]AirynS[/url][/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]. Thank you so much for letting us use your assets![/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]
Edits for [b]festival portraits and sprites[/b] for this mod are done in collaboration with [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193933561-queensnw/]Queensnw[/url]. [b]Queensnw[/b] did the initial edits and I finished the polishing of art and a coding part. Thank you so much for reaching out to me and helping with them. I wouldn't have done it alone anytime soon.
[/color]
It's been years since I first touched modding SV, I still don't know much bout coding, but at the beginning I was completely lost and I received help  here with where to even start. And I'm still very much grateful for it. Specifically to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/88107803]Jonqora[/url] who taught me how to edit sprites and portraits in a certain way. Thank you :)

Shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118355513]SoftPandaBoi[/url] for making Clint Reforged and being cool with me making an edit for their mod :)
